name: Steam
layout_summary: Top header bar: STORE, LIBRARY, COMMUNITY, and user profile tabs. In LIBRARY view: left sidebar has 'Search by name' filter and installed games list; main pane shows selected game hero banner with large green 'PLAY' (or blue 'INSTALL') button. Bottom bar: 'Add a Game', 'Manage Downloads' (center), 'Friends & Chat' (bottom-right).
avoid_traps: Do NOT confuse the Store search bar (top-right inside Store tab) with the Library search filter (top of left sidebar inside Library tab).
Clicking a game in the left Library list only opens its details page — you must then click the green 'PLAY' button in the main pane to launch it.

open_library.visual_fallback: smart_click('LIBRARY tab next to STORE at top')
open_library.verify: Steam switches to Library view with games list on the left

search_library.primary: smart_type('Search by name input at top of left sidebar', game_name, submit=false)
search_library.visual_fallback: smart_click('Search by name box in left sidebar') -> type_text(game_name)
search_library.verify: Left sidebar game list filters to matching titles

search_store.primary: smart_type('search box at top-right of Store page', query, submit=true)
search_store.visual_fallback: smart_click('search box at top-right of Store') -> type_text(query) -> press_key('enter')

launch_game.primary: smart_click('green PLAY button on game page')
launch_game.visual_fallback: smart_click('game title in left sidebar') -> smart_click('green PLAY button')
launch_game.verify: Button changes to 'STOP' or 'RUNNING' and the game window launches

open_downloads.visual_fallback: smart_click('Manage Downloads at bottom of window')
open_downloads.verify: Downloads manager view opens showing active and queued updates

open_friends.visual_fallback: smart_click('Friends menu in very top bar')
